### _build_recycled — src/mythosmini/data/cache.py
**Purpose:** Internal helper. Builds the cache across worker generations: opens the destination and progress bar once, then runs `_run_generation` per generation with carry-over quotas so shortfalls roll forward. Replaces `_build_parallel`, whose single long-lived workers leaked RSS proportional to documents streamed (observed ~3.5 GB/worker, 2026-06-11).
### _drain_queue — src/mythosmini/data/cache.py
**Purpose:** Internal helper.
### _run_generation — src/mythosmini/data/cache.py
**Purpose:** Internal helper. Spawns one generation of daemon shard workers on fresh shard indices, writes up to `limit` tokens from their queue, then terminates and joins them — bounding per-process memory growth.
### _shard_worker — src/mythosmini/data/cache.py
**Purpose:** Internal helper.
### _write_stream — src/mythosmini/data/cache.py
**Purpose:** Internal helper. Writes token chunks to an already-open handle up to `limit`, flushing every CACHE_FLUSH_TOKENS; returns tokens written. Core of `_write_tokens`, reused per generation.
### _write_tokens — src/mythosmini/data/cache.py
**Purpose:** Internal helper.
